layout: Mirror of Aurora-WebUI relative paths: vendor/webui/<path> is a verbatim copy of Aurora-WebUI/<path> except for the seams below. Relative imports resolve unchanged.
generated: descriptors.json (via gen-descriptors.py from core + Hue + Input descriptor tables)
notes: icon-paths: NavFooter.js + Dropdown.js page-relative icons/*.svg rewritten to vendor/webui/icons/* (CSS mask urls resolve relatively and needed no change)
string-zone-ids: ZoneActiveToggle.js Number(dataset.zoneId) replaced with type-tolerant lookup + unknown-id guard (native ids are uint8; demo room ids are strings)

toggle-sync: ZoneActiveToggleList.onChange + ZoneCanvas.onActiveChange/refreshActive keep Bridge and Zone Mapping bools on the same shared objects in sync; upstreamed in Aurora-ifkn.5, so the vendored screen is byte-identical to web/ui and wires both natively -- demo-boot.js's DemoDashboardScreen re-attach is now redundant but harmless (same wiring twice) until Aurora-ifkn.7 removes it

seams.note: DashboardScreen._renderBridgeContent navigates to OutputConnectScreen (NUX bridge setup). Never reachable in the demo: the shim answers /api/hue/connection as configured:true. OutputConnectScreen.js is vendored dead so the import resolves; it is never mounted.

Since Aurora-kea the Dashboard takes pickVideoInputName/pickAudioInputName from CaptureSource.js and no longer imports ModeDeviceScreen.js. That file stays vendored dead (never imported or mounted) until the fork is re-vendored.

Bare html/body rules (shell.css:18,23) and the * reset would leak onto the demo scene page. On vendoring, wrap them in the dashboard-pane scope class; re-apply on every re-vendor. Tokens (--aurora-*) and prefixed classes need no change.

DashboardScreen takes an app object (this.app.navigate). app.js/shell.js are NOT vendored; the demo boot provides a minimal facade. navigate() only needs to exist, never to work (seam no-output-connect); checkNow() always reads as reachable since the shim never drops; onStateUpdate/platform are plain fields the screen assigns.
